review_corrections: Sève objects to deriving socially developed motives from prior homeostatic needs; needs-first must distinguish embodied viability and object-mediated transformation.
Lahire does not assume everyone has plural dispositions; latent dispositions require actual observed formation, not fabricated invisibility.
Repetition does not automatically imply acquired anticipation; require actor exposure, enacted differentiation, context support and rival hypotheses.
Do not treat verbal sign-only as universally insufficient for learning. Distinguish instruction, practice, prior ability and independently warranted scope.
Complication/threat/repair require objective danger, actor-relative perceived danger, actual restorative activity and accessible uptake separately; formal operators unissued.
